_doc: Declaration registry for gzkit's policy/threshold config surface (GHI #929). Companion to data/waiver_ratchet_registry.json, which owns the waiver/grandfather family. Together the two are EXHAUSTIVE over data/*.json: `gz validate --config-registry` fail-closes on any top-level data registry that is neither matched by waiver_ratchet's filename globs nor declared here, so a new registry cannot enter the tree unowned. Each entry names a VERIFIED consumer, never an asserted one — the validator reads the declared owner and confirms it actually references the file, because a registry that merely lists filenames would be the presence-check-standing-in-for-a-state-check failure AGENTS.md forbids. `kind` selects which consumer channel is verified: 'code' owners must be a module under src/ that references the file; 'doc' owners must be a markdown surface that does. `relates_to` is checked for SYMMETRY, giving two registries that encode one concept a mechanical relation instead of a prose reconciliation buried in a _doc string that no parser reads (the measured instance in GHI #929: vendor-manifest's codex cap versus instructions_files_budget's ceiling, deliberately decoupled by operator ruling 2026-07-06 and discoverable only by reading a 20358-char comment). Adding a registry to data/ WITHOUT declaring it here is the silent-bypass this gate closes.

active_campaign.json.purpose: Active campaign identity and status, discharged out of transcribed prose.

agents_md_survival_declaration.json.purpose: Ranked AGENTS.md section survival order and must_survive_through_rank threshold.

check_scope_membership.json.purpose: Which validator scopes run under default `gz check` versus flag-gated.

check_step_concurrency.json.purpose: Per-step concurrency policy for the `gz check` runner.

config_registry.json.purpose: This registry — the declaration index for the policy/threshold config family.

distribution_baseline_manifest.json.purpose: Byte-equivalence baseline for the wheel-shipped canonical surface (ADR-0.0.31). Explicitly EXCLUDED from data/waiver_ratchet_registry.json as not gate-bearing-waiver, which is precisely why it needs an owner declared here.

exemplar_corpus.json.purpose: Empirically-measured exemplar corpus grounding complexity calibration.

frontier_model_cards.json.purpose: Frontier model cards for vendor tuning guidance. Doc-owned: cited by CLAUDE.md and the governance tuning surfaces; no code consumer reads it today, and this entry records that honestly rather than asserting a module that does not exist.

instructions_files_budget.json.purpose: Per-file char budgets for instructions/memory surfaces, and the decoupled ceiling.

mandated_tier1_dispatch.json.purpose: Which OBPI completions mandate a tier-1 adversarial dispatch.

security_surfaces.json.purpose: Registered security-sensitive surfaces driving the third sensitivity axis.

surface_weight_floor.json.purpose: Per-surface weight floors for the surface-weight audit.

transcribed_count_surfaces.json.purpose: Surfaces where a transcribed live count is refused in favour of a Layer-2 read.

vendor-manifest.json.purpose: Vendor delivery routes and content_type_delivery_caps (gzkit's belief about each vendor's physical truncation).

waiver_ratchet_registry.json.purpose: Declaration index for the waiver/grandfather family — the companion registry this one is exhaustive with.
